hypothesis: The published HMM-MOS decision rule (occupied<->free voxel state change) can or cannot flag a static obstacle on the track bed, and its nuisance load on real tunnel geometry with the measured beam pattern is small or large.
source: https://github.com/vb44/HMM-MOS commit 3f625031d135b2bbe4297125da11facdaba8ca81, built locally from source (nix clang/onetbb/yaml-cpp/nanoflann/unordered_dense)
note: Scene, beams, rails and tunnel geometry are exactly the project's measured-pattern stress scene (tunnel_guard.stress.scene_scan), so the sensor sampling is the measured sourcecraft ring/azimuth pattern. The one addition is that the inserted box may move or appear, which the panel does not exercise.
